Photo of the bottom interior section with all drawers present.
Close-up photos of the rubber gaskets around both doors.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's specification plate (usually on the back or inside) showing the model and capacity.
Video of the refrigerator plugged in and running, showing the interior light and compressor sound.
Photo of the bottom interior showing if the crisper drawer is present.
Photo of the rear of the refrigerator.
response.reason: The model number and capacity are required to distinguish this from other OMAHA units. Additionally, the exterior condition is poor, and proof of cooling is essential for an appliance in this state.
